_note: Project-authored CWE micro-rubrics (checklist style, following the CWE-specific rubric pattern of ZeroFalse, L9). Each tells the LLM what makes code vulnerable versus safe for that weakness class.

CWE-79.vulnerable_when: request/user-controlled data is written into HTML, DOM sinks (innerHTML, document.write) or unescaped template output
CWE-79.safe_when: output is HTML-escaped/encoded, textContent is used, or an auto-escaping template engine renders the value

CWE-89.vulnerable_when: SQL text is built by string concatenation/formatting with external input
CWE-89.safe_when: parameterised/prepared statements or an ORM binding is used and input never becomes SQL text

CWE-352.vulnerable_when: a state-changing request (POST/PUT/DELETE) relies only on ambient cookie/session credentials with no CSRF token, same-site protection or origin check
CWE-352.safe_when: an anti-CSRF token is verified, or SameSite=Strict/Lax plus origin checks protect the request

CWE-862.vulnerable_when: an action on a resource or privileged operation runs for an authenticated user without checking that user's permission/ownership/role
CWE-862.safe_when: an explicit authorization check (role, ownership, policy) gates the action before it executes

CWE-787.vulnerable_when: data is written past the end/start of a buffer because bounds are unchecked
CWE-787.safe_when: lengths are validated or bounds-checked APIs are used

CWE-22.vulnerable_when: external input is used to build a filesystem path without confining the resolved path to an allowed base directory
CWE-22.safe_when: the resolved path is verified to stay inside the base directory, or a safe API (send_from_directory) is used

CWE-416.vulnerable_when: memory is used after it has been freed
CWE-416.safe_when: pointers are cleared/ownership is clear after free

CWE-125.vulnerable_when: data is read past the bounds of a buffer

CWE-78.vulnerable_when: an OS command string is built from external input and run through a shell (os.system, shell=True, exec, execSync)
CWE-78.safe_when: arguments are passed as an argv list without a shell and input is validated

CWE-94.vulnerable_when: external input reaches eval/exec/new Function/template compilation or dynamic code loading
CWE-94.safe_when: only literal parsing (ast.literal_eval, JSON.parse) or an allow-list of fixed handlers is used

CWE-120.vulnerable_when: data is copied into a buffer without checking the destination size
CWE-120.safe_when: size-bounded copy functions with validated lengths are used

CWE-434.vulnerable_when: uploaded files are saved with attacker-controlled name/extension/type, especially under a web-served directory, without allow-listing
CWE-434.safe_when: extension/content type are allow-listed, names are regenerated and files are stored outside the web root

CWE-476.vulnerable_when: a value that can be None/null/undefined is dereferenced without a check
CWE-476.safe_when: the value is checked (or optional chaining/defaults used) before use

CWE-121.vulnerable_when: a stack buffer is overflowed by unchecked input length

CWE-502.vulnerable_when: untrusted data is deserialised with an unsafe deserialiser (pickle, yaml.load with full loader, node-serialize, marshal)
CWE-502.safe_when: a data-only format such as JSON or a safe loader (yaml.safe_load) is used

CWE-122.vulnerable_when: a heap buffer is overflowed by unchecked sizes
CWE-122.safe_when: allocation and copy sizes are validated

CWE-863.vulnerable_when: an authorization check exists but its logic is wrong (inverted condition, over-broad OR, trusting a client-supplied flag)
CWE-863.safe_when: the check correctly requires the intended role/ownership with no unintended bypass

CWE-20.vulnerable_when: external input is used without validating type, range, length or format, or is blindly mass-assigned
CWE-20.safe_when: input is validated against an allow-list/range or schema before use

CWE-284.vulnerable_when: access to a resource is controlled by something the client can spoof or by a missing/ineffective restriction
CWE-284.safe_when: access decisions rely on server-verified identity and permissions

CWE-200.vulnerable_when: sensitive data (secrets, stack traces, environment, credentials, PII) is returned to a user or exposed to the wrong party
CWE-200.safe_when: only generic messages/non-sensitive fields are exposed and details are logged server-side

CWE-306.vulnerable_when: a critical or administrative function is reachable without any authentication
CWE-306.safe_when: authentication (and role checks) middleware/decorators protect the function

CWE-918.vulnerable_when: the server fetches a URL supplied by the user without restricting scheme/host (internal addresses reachable)
CWE-918.safe_when: the target is validated against an allow-list of hosts/schemes and internal ranges are blocked

CWE-77.vulnerable_when: a command line is assembled from external input so that special characters alter the command
CWE-77.safe_when: fixed command with separate validated arguments and no shell interpretation

CWE-639.vulnerable_when: an object is fetched by an identifier taken from the request without verifying the requester may access that specific object
CWE-639.safe_when: the query is scoped to the current user/tenant or ownership is verified

CWE-770.vulnerable_when: resources (memory, rows, request size, connections) are allocated or returned without any limit or throttling
CWE-770.safe_when: explicit size, count, pagination or rate limits are enforced

CWE-798.vulnerable_when: a password, API key, token or private key is written as a literal in source and used for authentication or signing (not a placeholder that is read from the environment/secret store)
CWE-798.safe_when: the secret is read from environment variables/a secret manager, or the literal is clearly a test fixture or an example value that is not used

CWE-327.vulnerable_when: MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC4 or ECB mode is used for a security purpose (passwords, signatures, encryption, tokens)
CWE-327.safe_when: a modern algorithm (AES-GCM, SHA-256+, Argon2/bcrypt for passwords) is used, or the weak hash is used only for a non-security purpose such as a cache key or ETag

CWE-328.vulnerable_when: a fast or collision-prone hash (MD5, SHA-1, unsalted SHA-256) protects a password or must resist collisions
CWE-328.safe_when: a slow salted password hash is used, or the hash is non-security use only

CWE-916.vulnerable_when: passwords are hashed with a fast general hash or very few iterations
CWE-916.safe_when: bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2/PBKDF2 with a high work factor and per-user salt is used

CWE-330.vulnerable_when: tokens, session ids, reset codes, keys or passwords are generated with random/Math.random or another predictable source
CWE-330.safe_when: secrets.token_*, os.urandom, crypto.randomBytes/randomUUID or another CSPRNG is used, or randomness is not security relevant

CWE-338.vulnerable_when: Math.random/random module/rand() supplies a security value
CWE-338.safe_when: a cryptographically secure generator is used or the value has no security role (shuffling UI items, jitter)

CWE-295.vulnerable_when: TLS certificate or hostname verification is disabled (verify=False, rejectUnauthorized:false, CERT_NONE, check_hostname False)
CWE-295.safe_when: default certificate verification is left on or a pinned CA bundle is supplied

CWE-347.vulnerable_when: a signature/JWT is decoded without verification, verification is disabled, or the algorithm is taken from the token
CWE-347.safe_when: the signature is verified with a fixed expected algorithm and key

CWE-319.vulnerable_when: credentials or sensitive data are sent over http://, FTP, Telnet or an unencrypted socket
CWE-319.safe_when: https/TLS is used for the transmission, or traffic stays on a loopback test address

CWE-312.vulnerable_when: sensitive data (tokens, passwords, personal data) is stored unencrypted in files, localStorage, cookies or databases
CWE-312.safe_when: data is encrypted at rest or not stored

CWE-532.vulnerable_when: passwords, tokens, secrets or personal data are written to logs or console output
CWE-532.safe_when: sensitive values are redacted or never logged

CWE-209.vulnerable_when: exception text, stack traces, SQL or internal paths are returned in the response/UI
CWE-209.safe_when: a generic message is returned and the detail is only logged server-side

CWE-489.vulnerable_when: debug mode/debugger or a test backdoor is enabled for the deployed app (app.run(debug=True), DEBUG=True)
CWE-489.safe_when: debug is controlled by an environment setting that is off in production

CWE-307.vulnerable_when: a login, OTP or password-reset endpoint accepts unlimited attempts with no rate limit, lockout or delay
CWE-307.safe_when: attempt counting, lockout, throttling or CAPTCHA protects the endpoint

CWE-287.vulnerable_when: the code treats a client-supplied identity (header, parameter, cookie) as proof of who the user is, or skips credential verification
CWE-287.safe_when: identity comes from a verified session/token and credentials are checked

CWE-384.vulnerable_when: the session id is kept after login without regeneration, or accepted from the URL
CWE-384.safe_when: the session is regenerated/cleared at login

CWE-613.vulnerable_when: sessions/tokens have no expiry, a huge lifetime, or stay valid after logout
CWE-613.safe_when: tokens carry a reasonable expiry and are invalidated on logout/password change

CWE-601.vulnerable_when: the application redirects to a URL taken from the request without restricting it to local paths or allow-listed hosts
CWE-601.safe_when: the target is validated against an allow-list or only relative internal paths are accepted

CWE-611.vulnerable_when: an XML parser resolves external entities or DTDs on untrusted XML
CWE-611.safe_when: entity resolution/DTD loading is disabled or a defused parser is used

CWE-1333.vulnerable_when: a regular expression with nested quantifiers/overlapping alternation is applied to untrusted input without a length limit
CWE-1333.safe_when: the pattern is linear-time, inputs are length-limited or a safe regex engine is used

CWE-1321.vulnerable_when: untrusted keys such as __proto__/constructor/prototype are merged or assigned into objects recursively
CWE-1321.safe_when: keys are filtered, Object.create(null)/Map is used, or the merge library is patched

CWE-915.vulnerable_when: a whole request body is bound to a model/object (**request.json, Object.assign(model, req.body)) allowing fields like role/isAdmin to be set
CWE-915.safe_when: only an allow-list of fields is copied

CWE-732.vulnerable_when: files, directories or resources are created with overly permissive modes (0o777, world-writable)

CWE-377.vulnerable_when: a predictable or shared temporary file name is created in a world-writable directory (tempfile.mktemp, /tmp/fixed)
CWE-377.safe_when: tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile/mkstemp with exclusive creation is used

CWE-346.vulnerable_when: an Origin/Host/Referer header is trusted for an authorisation decision or reflected into CORS headers
CWE-346.safe_when: the origin is checked against an exact allow-list

CWE-942.vulnerable_when: CORS allows any origin (*) or reflects the Origin header together with credentials
CWE-942.safe_when: a specific allow-list of origins is configured

CWE-1021.vulnerable_when: pages can be framed by any site because no X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors is set on sensitive pages

CWE-614.vulnerable_when: a session/auth cookie is set without the Secure flag

CWE-1004.vulnerable_when: a session/auth cookie is set without HttpOnly

CWE-362.vulnerable_when: a shared resource is checked and then modified non-atomically (read-modify-write, check then act) in concurrent code
CWE-362.safe_when: a lock, transaction, atomic update or unique constraint protects the sequence

CWE-367.vulnerable_when: a file or record state is checked (exists, access, balance) and used later in separate steps that an attacker can race
CWE-367.safe_when: the operation is atomic (open with O_EXCL, single transaction/update) or the check and use are combined

CWE-400.vulnerable_when: input-controlled sizes, loop counts, uploads or unbounded caches can consume unlimited CPU/memory/disk
CWE-400.safe_when: limits, timeouts, pagination and eviction bound the resource use

CWE-409.vulnerable_when: compressed or archive data is expanded without a limit on the resulting size or file count
CWE-409.safe_when: the expanded size and entry count are capped before/while extracting

CWE-799.vulnerable_when: an abusable function (email/SMS send, signup, reset, expensive search) is callable unlimited times
CWE-799.safe_when: a rate limit, CAPTCHA or quota is applied

CWE-829.vulnerable_when: code, modules or plugins are loaded from a path or URL controlled by the user or an untrusted third party
CWE-829.safe_when: only fixed, vetted modules are loaded and remote code is pinned/verified

CWE-494.vulnerable_when: code or updates are downloaded and executed without a checksum or signature check
CWE-494.safe_when: the artifact is verified with a pinned hash or signature before use

CWE-426.vulnerable_when: programs or libraries are resolved through a search path an attacker can write to (cwd, user-controlled PATH/sys.path)
CWE-426.safe_when: absolute paths are used or the search path is fixed and trusted

CWE-1395.vulnerable_when: the manifest pins a dependency version known to contain public vulnerabilities
CWE-1395.safe_when: the dependency is on a patched version or is not used in the vulnerable way

CWE-636.vulnerable_when: an error, exception or timeout in a security check results in access being granted (fail open)

CWE-755.vulnerable_when: exceptions are swallowed (except: pass, empty catch) around security-relevant operations so execution continues unsafely
CWE-755.safe_when: errors are handled explicitly, logged and fail closed

CWE-208.vulnerable_when: secrets, tokens or MACs are compared with ==/=== (early-exit comparison)
CWE-208.safe_when: a constant-time comparison (hmac.compare_digest, crypto.timingSafeEqual) is used

CWE-204.vulnerable_when: responses differ for existing versus unknown accounts (message, status code), enabling user enumeration
CWE-204.safe_when: the same generic response is returned either way

CWE-117.vulnerable_when: untrusted input is written into log lines without neutralising CR/LF, enabling forged entries
CWE-117.safe_when: newlines are stripped/escaped or structured logging is used

CWE-113.vulnerable_when: untrusted input is placed in an HTTP header without stripping CR/LF
CWE-113.safe_when: header values are validated/encoded, or the framework rejects newlines

CWE-95.vulnerable_when: untrusted input reaches eval/Function/exec as code text
CWE-95.safe_when: only fixed code is run and input is treated as data

CWE-1336.vulnerable_when: user input is concatenated into a template string that is then compiled/rendered (render_template_string, ejs.render of user text)
CWE-1336.safe_when: user input is passed only as template context variables

CWE-643.vulnerable_when: user input is concatenated into an XPath/XQuery expression
CWE-643.safe_when: parameterised XPath or escaping is used

CWE-943.vulnerable_when: a NoSQL/query object is built directly from request data (operators like $ne, $gt can be injected)
CWE-943.safe_when: inputs are cast to primitive types and operator keys are rejected

CWE-90.vulnerable_when: user input is concatenated into an LDAP filter or DN without escaping
CWE-90.safe_when: filter/DN escaping or parameterised LDAP queries are used

CWE-88.vulnerable_when: user input can become an option/flag of an external program (leading dash, extra arguments)
CWE-88.safe_when: arguments are validated, '--' terminates options, or a fixed argument list is used

CWE-269.vulnerable_when: privilege is raised or a role assigned based on user-controlled input or without checks
CWE-269.safe_when: privilege changes require verified authority and least privilege

CWE-250.vulnerable_when: the process or container runs as root/admin where it is not needed

CWE-276.vulnerable_when: sensitive files or objects are created with default or broad permissions
CWE-276.safe_when: restrictive permissions are set explicitly at creation

CWE-807.vulnerable_when: a security decision (admin, role, internal) depends on a header, cookie or parameter the client controls
CWE-807.safe_when: decisions use server-verified identity and state

CWE-602.vulnerable_when: validation/authorisation exists only in client-side code (browser JS, hidden buttons) with no server check
CWE-602.safe_when: the same checks are enforced on the server

CWE-565.vulnerable_when: a role, price or user id is read from a cookie that is unsigned and unverified
CWE-565.safe_when: cookies are signed/encrypted or state is kept server side

CWE-345.vulnerable_when: webhook or callback payloads are accepted without verifying a signature/origin
CWE-345.safe_when: a signature or shared-secret HMAC is verified before processing

CWE-940.vulnerable_when: a message/postMessage/socket handler acts on data without checking event.origin or the sender
CWE-940.safe_when: the origin or sender is validated against an allow-list

CWE-1385.vulnerable_when: a WebSocket server accepts any Origin and relies on cookies
CWE-1385.safe_when: the Origin header is checked or token authentication is required
